episodeTitle.en: Product management theater | Marty Cagan (Silicon Valley Product Group)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品管理戏码 | 马蒂·卡根（硅谷产品集团）

guestBioOfficial.en: Marty Cagan is a luminary in the world of product. He’s the author of two of the most foundational books for product teams and product leaders (Inspired and Empowered), he’s the founder of Silicon Valley Product Group (one of the longest-running product advisory groups), and he’s almost certainly worked with more product leaders and teams than any human alive. Now he’s releasing his newest book, Transformed, which is sure to become a staple of tech-powered companies worldwide. Marty’s previous appearance on our show remains one of the most popular episodes to date. In this conversation, we discuss: • The rise of “product management theater”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马蒂·卡根是产品界的泰斗人物。他著有两本面向产品团队和产品负责人的基础读物（《启发》和《赋能》），创立了运营时间最长的产品顾问团体之一——硅谷产品集团，并且与全球众多产品负责人及团队合作的次数比其他任何人都多。如今，他即将推出新作《蜕变》，必将成为全球科技型企业的必备读物。马蒂此前在我们节目中的亮相仍是迄今最受欢迎的剧集之一。在本次对谈中，我们将探讨：• “产品管理戏码”的兴起

title.en: Product management theater | Marty Cagan (Silicon Valley Product Group)
title.zh: 产品管理戏码 | 马蒂·卡根（硅谷产品集团）

summary.en: Marty argues many companies overhired during the pandemic, creating fake product roles like agile coaches and product owners that deliver output, not outcomes. He pushes back on the "victim" mindset, insisting individual contributors can drive real change from within. The episode is a bracing call to rediscover what true product management looks like.
summary.zh: 马蒂认为，许多公司在疫情期间过度招聘，制造出敏捷教练、产品负责人等"假产品角色"，它们只交付产出而非成果。他反对"受害者"心态，坚持一线产品人也能从内部推动真正的改变。本期是一次令人警醒的呼吁：重新发现真正产品管理的模样。
